interpretation: A 0.01 familywise exceedance budget is used as a transparent diagnostic 99% represented-support envelope. It is not an operationally accepted lunar-site risk threshold.
non_claims: No Gaussian or other tail distribution is assumed.
No pixel independence or covariance structure is assumed.
The RMS map is not relabeled as a deterministic terrain bound.
The familywise theorem covers represented admitted raster support points only; unresolved physical terrain remains an LL-009R obligation.
The nominal observer in LL-009W does not close Site01 observer uncertainty; memberwise observer propagation remains LL-009U/its successor's responsibility.
